$comment: KPI dashboard tab: an Executive-style visual summary built from the office statements of the Offices instance named in app.config.json kpiDashboard.source (officesSheet = the client's column-E account map in config/offices-sheet.json; offices = config/offices.json). Every metric key is a statement row key of that config, or pct:<row key> = the row as % of net collections. The period is the header date range (the unfinished current month is left out); the comparison is the same months a year earlier. Restart the server after editing.

trend.$comment: Two charts: bars by month (with the same month last year as a line) and line by month with its % of collections.

leaderboard.$comment: Office table: columns in order, default sort column (descending), spark = sparkline metric by month.

heatmap.$comment: Office x month grid. clampPercent: full color at this many % (percent metrics) above / below zero.

costStructure.$comment: Each row as % of collections by office. rows: [] = every cost, other and fees row of the statement, in statement order.

movers.$comment: Accounts that moved EBITDA the most vs the same months last year: this many up and this many down.

bridge.$comment: Waterfall from net collections through each cost row and the management fees to office EBITDA.

offices.$comment: Only offices in these page.portfolio.buckets of the source Offices config (null = every office). The dental world: Sabuska and the dental practices with their sub-DSOs; real estate and other companies are left out of the KPI dashboard.
